paul.q: Colossians 1:15 calls Christ the image of whom?
paul.explain: Colossians 1:15 says He is the image of the invisible God.

paul.q: 2 Thessalonians 3:10 says if anyone will not work, neither shall he do what?
paul.explain: 2 Thessalonians 3:10: if any would not work, neither should he eat.

paul.q: What does 1 Timothy 6:10 call a root of all kinds of evil?
paul.explain: 1 Timothy 6:10 says the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

paul.q: Which fruit of the Spirit is listed first in Galatians 5:22?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:22 begins the fruit of the Spirit with love.

paul.q: Which fruit of the Spirit means waiting calmly without getting angry?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:22 lists patience (longsuffering) among the fruit of the Spirit.

paul.q: How many fruits of the Spirit are listed in Galatians 5:22-23?
paul.explain: Paul lists nine: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

paul.q: Whose schemes can we stand against by putting on God's armour?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:11 says to put on God's armour to stand against the devil's schemes.

paul.q: Which Bible chapter is often called the love chapter?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13 describes what love is and does.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:8, what does love never do?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:8 says love never fails.

paul.q: Instead of worrying, what does Philippians 4:6 tell us to do with everything?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:6 says do not be anxious, but bring everything to God in prayer with thanksgiving.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:2 says to honour your father and whom?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:2 says to honour your father and mother.

paul.q: Romans 12:21 says to overcome evil with what?
paul.explain: Romans 12:21 says do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

paul.q: What does Galatians 6:2 tell us to carry for one another?
paul.explain: Galatians 6:2 says to bear one another's burdens.

paul.q: In Ephesians 6:10, Paul says to be strong in whom?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:10 says to be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might.

paul.q: What had Timothy known from childhood, according to 2 Timothy 3:15?
paul.explain: 2 Timothy 3:15 says from childhood Timothy had known the holy Scriptures.

paul.q: Who wrote the letters from Romans to Philemon?
paul.explain: Romans 1:1 opens, 'Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ.'

paul.q: According to Philippians 4:19, God will supply all your what?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:19 promises that God will supply all your needs.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 says that in everything we should do what?
paul.explain: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 says in everything give thanks.

paul.q: Romans 8:39 says nothing can separate us from what?
paul.explain: Romans 8:38-39 says nothing can separate us from God's love in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: Philippians 2:14 says to do all things without what?
paul.explain: Philippians 2:14 says to do all things without complaining and arguing.

paul.q: Which of Paul's letters contains the love chapter?
paul.explain: The love chapter is 1 Corinthians 13.

paul.q: Which letter of Paul lists the fruit of the Spirit?
paul.explain: The fruit of the Spirit is listed in Galatians 5:22-23.

paul.q: Which letter says, 'Rejoice in the Lord always'?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:4 says to rejoice in the Lord always.

paul.q: In which letter does Paul tell Titus to appoint elders in every town?
paul.explain: Titus 1:5 says Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders in every town.

paul.q: According to Ephesians 2:9, why is salvation not by works?
paul.a: So that no one may boast
options: So that no one may boast
So that no one may rest
So that no one may travel
So that no one may sing
paul.explain: Ephesians 2:8-9 says salvation is not of works, so that no one can boast.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:12 says our struggle is not against what?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:12 says we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against spiritual forces of evil.

paul.q: According to Galatians 2:16, a person is justified by faith in whom?
paul.explain: Galatians 2:16 says we are justified by faith in Jesus Christ, not by works of the law.

paul.q: Galatians 5:13 says to serve one another through what?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:13 says to serve one another in love.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:2, if I have all faith to move mountains but no love, I am what?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:2 says without love, even mountain-moving faith leaves me nothing.

paul.q: Which of these does the love chapter say love does NOT do?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:4 says love does not envy; verses 6-7 say it rejoices with the truth, hopes and endures.

paul.q: Romans 8:1 says there is now no what for those in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: Romans 8:1 says there is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: In Romans 12:1, Paul urges us to present our bodies as what?
paul.explain: Romans 12:1 urges us to present our bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God.

paul.q: Romans 5:1 says that being justified by faith, we have peace with whom?
paul.explain: Romans 5:1 says we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

paul.q: In Philippians 4:7, what guards our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:7 says the peace of God, which surpasses understanding, will guard hearts and minds.

paul.q: According to 2 Corinthians 5:7, we walk by faith, not by what?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 5:7 says we walk by faith, not by sight.

paul.q: After describing the armour of God, what does Paul urge in Ephesians 6:18?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:18 urges praying at all times in the Spirit.

paul.q: In Galatians 1:6, Paul is astonished that the Galatians are turning to a different what?
paul.explain: Galatians 1:6 expresses amazement that they were turning to a different gospel.

paul.q: In Galatians 3:24, the law was a guardian to lead us to whom?
paul.explain: Galatians 3:24 says the law was our guardian (tutor) until Christ came, that we might be justified by faith.

paul.q: Whom does Romans 4:3 cite as believing God and having it counted to him as righteousness?
paul.explain: Romans 4:3 quotes Genesis: Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness.

paul.q: According to Colossians 3:14, what binds everything together in perfect unity?
paul.explain: Colossians 3:14 says to put on love, which binds everything together in perfect unity.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 8:9, Christ became poor so that we through His poverty might become what?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 8:9 says though He was rich, He became poor so that we might become rich.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 15:3, Christ died for our sins according to what?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:3 says Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:5 says 'one Lord, one faith, one ___'.
paul.explain: Ephesians 4:5 reads 'one Lord, one faith, one baptism.'

paul.q: In Philemon 1:16, Paul asks Philemon to receive Onesimus as more than a slave, as what?
paul.explain: Philemon 1:16 asks him to receive Onesimus as a beloved brother.

paul.q: Titus 3:5 says God saved us not by our works but according to His what?
paul.explain: Titus 3:5 says He saved us according to His mercy, not by works of righteousness we had done.

paul.q: Colossians 3:12 says to clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and what?
paul.explain: Paul lists the qualities God's chosen people put on like clothing.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:26 says not to let what go down while you are still angry?
paul.explain: Deal with anger quickly and do not hold on to it.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:11 says to encourage one another and do what?
paul.explain: Believers are to strengthen one another.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:4 tells fathers not to do what to their children?
paul.explain: Fathers are to bring children up in the training and instruction of the Lord.

paul.q: Who was Timothy's grandmother, mentioned in 2 Timothy 1:5?
paul.explain: Paul remembers the sincere faith that lived first in Lois and then in Eunice, Timothy's mother.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 1:3 calls God the Father of mercies and the God of all what?
paul.explain: The letter of 2 Corinthians has a strong theme of God's comfort.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:15 says to speak the truth in what?
paul.explain: Truth is to be spoken with love as we grow up into Christ.

paul.q: Colossians 3:20 says that children obeying their parents in everything pleases whom?
paul.explain: Obeying parents is well-pleasing to the Lord.

paul.q: Philippians 2:3 says in humility to value others above what?
paul.explain: Paul teaches humility and putting others first.

paul.q: Whom does 1 Timothy 2:1-2 say to pray for, along with all people?
paul.explain: Paul urges prayers for everyone, including those who govern.

paul.q: Romans 12:15 says to do what with those who weep?
paul.explain: Rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep.

paul.q: Romans 12:13 says to practise what toward guests and strangers?
paul.explain: Believers are to share with God's people and welcome others in.

paul.q: Romans 12:18 says, as far as it depends on you, live at what with everyone?
paul.explain: Paul urges us to seek peace with all people.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:2 calls honouring your father and mother the first commandment with what?
paul.explain: The commandment comes with a promise of blessing.

paul.q: Galatians 6:7 says whatever a person sows, that they will also do what?
paul.explain: Paul uses a farming picture: what you plant is what you harvest.

paul.q: Philippians 4:8 says to think about whatever is true, noble, right, pure and what?
paul.explain: Paul tells believers to fill their minds with good things.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 16:14 says to do everything in what?
paul.explain: Paul closes 1 Corinthians with a short, simple command.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 16:13 says to stand firm in what?
paul.explain: Paul tells the church to be watchful, courageous and strong.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 2:3, Paul tells Timothy to endure hardship like a good what?
paul.explain: Paul uses the picture of a soldier of Christ Jesus.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:10 says we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do what?
paul.explain: God prepared good works in advance for us to walk in.

paul.q: Colossians 3:13 says to forgive as who forgave you?
paul.explain: We forgive others because the Lord has forgiven us.

paul.q: Romans 12:12 says to be faithful in what?
paul.explain: Paul says be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

paul.q: Which young co-worker is named with Paul in the opening greeting of Colossians?
paul.explain: Colossians begins 'Paul... and Timothy our brother'.

paul.q: Colossians 1:18 says Christ is the head of what body?
paul.explain: Christ is supreme and head of the church.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 12:21, the eye cannot say to the hand, what?
paul.explain: Every part of Christ's body is needed.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 12:4 says there are different kinds of gifts but the same what?
paul.explain: Many gifts, one Spirit who gives them.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 14:1 says to eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially which gift?
paul.explain: Paul says to pursue love and desire spiritual gifts, especially prophecy.

paul.q: Which of these gifts is listed in Romans 12:6-8?
paul.explain: The list includes prophecy, serving, teaching, encouraging, giving, leading and mercy.

paul.q: Which of these roles does Ephesians 4:11 list among Christ's gifts to the church?
paul.explain: Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 15:20 calls Christ the what of those who have fallen asleep?
paul.explain: Christ's resurrection is the first of the harvest.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 1:4, God comforts us so that we can do what for others in trouble?
paul.explain: The comfort we receive is shared with others.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 4:7, Paul says we have this treasure in what?
paul.explain: Ordinary jars show that the power belongs to God, not us.

paul.q: According to 2 Corinthians 5:17, if anyone is in Christ, they are a what?
paul.explain: The old has gone, the new has come.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 5:20, Paul calls believers Christ's what?
paul.explain: We represent Christ as though God were making His appeal through us.

paul.q: Galatians 3:28 says that all are what in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female.

paul.q: What does Galatians 5:1 say Christ has set us free for?
paul.explain: Paul urges the Galatians to stand firm and not return to slavery.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:20 calls Christ Jesus the chief what of God's household?
paul.explain: The household is built on the apostles and prophets with Christ as cornerstone.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:22-24 says to put off your old self and put on the what?
paul.explain: The new self is created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

paul.q: Colossians 3:15 says to let the peace of Christ do what in your hearts?
paul.explain: Christ's peace is to be the umpire of our hearts.

paul.q: In Philippians 3:14, Paul presses on toward the goal to win what?
paul.explain: He presses on toward the prize of God's heavenly call in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: In Philippians 1:21, Paul says that to die is what?
paul.explain: For Paul, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

paul.q: According to Romans 1:17, the righteous shall live by what?
paul.explain: The theme of Romans is righteousness by faith.

paul.q: Romans 8:37 says that in all these things we are more than what?
paul.explain: Through Christ who loved us, we overcome.

paul.q: In 1 Thessalonians 4:13, Paul says believers should not grieve like others who have no what?
paul.explain: Christians have hope because of Christ's resurrection.

paul.q: According to Romans 3:28, a person is justified by faith apart from what?
paul.explain: Justification is by faith, not by keeping the law.

paul.q: In Romans 5, one man's disobedience made many sinners. Through whose obedience will many be made righteous?
paul.explain: Adam's disobedience is set against Christ's obedience.

paul.q: Romans 11:33 marvels at the depth of the riches of God's wisdom and what?
paul.explain: Paul ends this section in worship at God's unsearchable wisdom.

paul.q: Which woman does Paul commend as a servant of the church in Cenchreae?
paul.explain: Phoebe is commended at the close of Romans.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 1:18, the message of the cross is what to those who are being saved?
paul.explain: To those perishing it is foolishness, but to believers it is God's power.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 2:2, Paul resolved to know nothing except Jesus Christ and Him what?
paul.explain: Paul focused his preaching on the cross.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 11:24, Jesus said to eat the bread in what of Him?
paul.explain: Paul passes on the words of the Lord's Supper.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 12:10, Paul says that when he is weak, then he is what?
paul.explain: Christ's power is made perfect in weakness.

paul.q: In Galatians 6:14, Paul says he will never boast except in what?
paul.a: The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
options: The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
paul.explain: The cross is the centre of Paul's boasting.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:3 says to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of what?
paul.explain: Unity in the body of Christ is held by peace.

paul.q: Ephesians 5:18 says do not get drunk on wine, but be filled with what?
paul.explain: Believers are called to be continually filled with the Holy Spirit.

generalrev.q: Jesus says, "Behold, I stand at the door and ___."
generalrev.explain: In Revelation 3:20 Jesus stands at the door and knocks.

generalrev.q: Who will wipe away every tear from our eyes in heaven?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:4 says God will wipe away every tear.

generalrev.q: Finish the verse: "God is ___."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:8 tells us that God is love.

generalrev.q: "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and ___."
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:8 says Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

generalrev.q: If we need wisdom, whom does James say we should ask?
generalrev.explain: James 1:5 says to ask God, who gives generously.

generalrev.q: According to 1 Peter 5:7, why can we give our worries to God?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:7 says to give God our worries because he cares for you.

generalrev.q: "If we confess our sins, God will ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 1:9 promises that God forgives us when we confess our sins.

generalrev.q: Which book is the very last book of the Bible?
generalrev.explain: Revelation ends the Bible, closing at Revelation 22:21.

generalrev.q: What were the streets of the city of heaven made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says the street of the city was pure gold.

generalrev.q: What was each of the twelve gates of the new city made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says each gate was made of a single pearl.

generalrev.q: Who built an ark by faith to save his family?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:7 says Noah by faith built an ark.

generalrev.q: Who obeyed God by faith and went out not knowing where he was going?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:8 says Abraham obeyed and went out not knowing where he was going.

generalrev.q: Which hero of faith refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:24 says Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

generalrev.q: By faith, the walls of which city fell after the Israelites marched around them for seven days?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:30 says the walls of Jericho fell by faith.

generalrev.q: Which woman in Hebrews 11 welcomed the spies in peace and was spared?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:31 says Rahab welcomed the spies and did not perish.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 11, who was taken from this life so that he did not experience death?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:5 says by faith Enoch was taken so that he did not see death.

generalrev.q: James says, "Faith without ___ is dead."
generalrev.explain: James 2:17 says faith by itself, if it has no works, is dead.

generalrev.q: James compares which small part of the body to a fire that can set a forest ablaze?
generalrev.explain: James 3:5-6 says the tongue is a small part but is like a fire.

generalrev.q: James says to consider it pure joy whenever you face what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:2 says to count it joy when you face trials of many kinds.

generalrev.q: "Resist the devil, and he will ___ from you."
generalrev.explain: James 4:7 promises the devil will flee when we resist him.

generalrev.q: Abraham was called what of God?
generalrev.explain: James 2:23 says Abraham was called the friend of God.

generalrev.q: "I saw a new heaven and a new ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:1 says John saw a new heaven and a new earth.

generalrev.q: By faith, which son did Abraham offer up when God tested him?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:17 says Abraham offered up Isaac.

generalrev.q: Peter says the devil prowls around like what kind of animal?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:8 says the devil prowls around like a roaring lion.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:2 tells us to fix our eyes on whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:2 says to fix our eyes on Jesus.

generalrev.q: "We love because he first ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:19 says we love because God first loved us.

generalrev.q: How many churches are addressed in the letters of Revelation 2 and 3?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:11 sends the message to seven churches in Asia.

generalrev.q: The Lord says, "I am the Alpha and the ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:8 says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega."

generalrev.q: On which island was John when he received the revelation?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:9 says John was on the island of Patmos.

generalrev.q: Hebrews says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 5:6 says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

generalrev.q: Which church was told it had forsaken its first love?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:4 tells the church in Ephesus it left its first love.

generalrev.q: Which church was rebuked for being neither hot nor cold?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:16 rebukes Laodicea as lukewarm.

generalrev.q: What name is given to the holy city John saw coming down out of heaven from God?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:2 calls it the holy city, the new Jerusalem.

generalrev.q: Which archangel is said to have disputed with the devil about the body of Moses?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:9 names the archangel Michael.

generalrev.q: John writes that we have what with the Father in Jesus Christ the righteous?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 2:1 says we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:5, Jesus is called the Lion of which tribe?

generalrev.q: Who received strength by faith to become a mother, because she trusted God to keep his promise?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:11 says Sarah considered God faithful who had promised.

generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:6 says without faith it is impossible to please God.

He will let us decide alone
He will stay only on Sundays

generalrev.q: 1 John 1:5 says that God is what?

generalrev.q: Jude 1:24 says God is able to keep us from what?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:24 praises him who is able to keep you from falling.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 3:9, the Lord is what toward us?

generalrev.q: James 4:8 says if we draw near to God, he will do what?
generalrev.explain: James 4:8 says, draw near to God and he will draw near to you.

generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:23 says Moses was hidden for three months by his parents.

generalrev.q: Which prophet does James say prayed earnestly that it would not rain?
generalrev.explain: James 5:17 says Elijah prayed earnestly that it would not rain.

generalrev.explain: James 3:4 says ships are steered by a very small rudder.

generalrev.q: James says even who believe that there is one God, and shudder?
generalrev.explain: James 2:19 says even the demons believe and shudder.

generalrev.q: Peter says believers, like living stones, are being built into what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:5 says you are being built up as a spiritual house.

generalrev.q: Peter compares the testing of our faith to which precious metal refined by fire?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 1:7 compares tested faith to gold refined by fire.

generalrev.q: With the Lord, one day is like how many years?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 3:8 says one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.

generalrev.q: By faith, who offered God a better sacrifice than Cain?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:4 says by faith Abel offered a better sacrifice than Cain.

generalrev.q: James says every good and perfect gift comes down from whom?
generalrev.explain: James 1:17 says every good gift comes from the Father of lights.

generalrev.q: Jude urges believers to do what for the faith once delivered to the saints?

generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:8 gives Philadelphia an open door no one can shut.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5, who is found worthy to open the scroll?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:9 says the Lamb is worthy to take the scroll and open its seals.

generalrev.q: Whose names were on the twelve foundations of the wall of the new Jerusalem?
generalrev.a: The twelve apostles of the Lamb
options: The twelve apostles of the Lamb

generalrev.q: In 3 John, which man is described as loving to be first among them?
generalrev.explain: 3 John 1:9 names Diotrephes, who loves to be first.

generalrev.q: 2 John is addressed to whom?
generalrev.a: The chosen lady and her children
options: The chosen lady and her children

generalrev.q: Jude calls himself a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:1 calls him the brother of James.

generalrev.q: Which church was told, "Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life"?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:10 gives this word to the church in Smyrna.

generalrev.q: Which church had a reputation for being alive, yet was dead?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:1 tells Sardis it has a name of being alive but is dead.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:6 says the Lord disciplines whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:6 says the Lord disciplines the one he loves.

generalrev.q: 3 John says there is no greater joy than to hear that his children are doing what?
generalrev.explain: 3 John 1:4 says no greater joy than to hear my children walk in truth.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 22:13, Jesus calls himself the Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:13 says, I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end.

generalrev.q: With what can we come to God's throne of grace?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:16 invites us to approach the throne of grace with confidence to receive mercy and help.

generalrev.q: Who is our great high priest who has gone into heaven?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:14 says we have a great high priest, Jesus the Son of God.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:2 says some people have welcomed whom without knowing it?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:2 says some have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 10:25 says not to give up what together?
generalrev.explain: We are told not to give up meeting together but to encourage one another.

generalrev.q: What does James 5:13 say a cheerful person should do?
generalrev.explain: James 5:13 says if anyone is cheerful, let them sing songs of praise.

generalrev.q: According to James 4:6, God gives grace to whom?
generalrev.explain: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 5:6 says if we humble ourselves, God will do what in due time?
generalrev.explain: Humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 4:8 says love covers what?
generalrev.explain: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers a multitude of sins.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 4:7, where does love come from?
generalrev.explain: Love comes from God, and everyone who loves is born of God.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:4 says the One in you is what than the one in the world?
generalrev.explain: God, who is in believers, is greater than the one who is in the world.

generalrev.q: 1 John 1:7 says the blood of Jesus purifies us from what?
generalrev.explain: The blood of Jesus his Son purifies us from all sin.

generalrev.q: In John's vision, what encircled God's throne, shining like an emerald?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:3 describes a rainbow shining like an emerald around the throne.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 19:11, the rider on the white horse is called Faithful and what?
generalrev.explain: The rider is called Faithful and True.

generalrev.q: What flows from the throne of God and of the Lamb?
generalrev.a: The river of the water of life
options: The river of the water of life

generalrev.q: Jude 1:2 prays for mercy, peace and what to be yours in abundance?
generalrev.explain: Jude greets believers: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.

generalrev.q: 2 Peter 3:18 says to grow in the grace and what of our Lord Jesus?
generalrev.explain: Peter ends by urging us to grow in grace and knowledge of Jesus.

generalrev.q: Where does God make his home with his people in the new creation?
generalrev.explain: A loud voice says God's dwelling is now among his people, and he will be with them.

generalrev.q: When we ask God for wisdom, James 1:6 says we should not do what?
generalrev.explain: We must ask in faith, not doubting.

generalrev.q: 1 John 3:18 says to love not just with words but with what?
generalrev.explain: John says to love not with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

generalrev.q: What is said about the gates of the new city in Revelation 21:25?
generalrev.explain: Its gates will never be shut, for there is no night there.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 1:3 calls the Son the radiance of what?
generalrev.explain: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact representation of his being.

generalrev.q: Although Jesus was tempted in every way as we are, what was he?
generalrev.explain: Our high priest sympathizes with our weaknesses yet was without sin.

generalrev.q: Why can Jesus save completely those who come to God through him, per Hebrews 7:25?
generalrev.a: He always lives to intercede for them
options: He has retired from his work
He always lives to intercede for them
generalrev.explain: Jesus always lives to intercede for those who draw near to God through him.

generalrev.q: How many times did Jesus offer his body as a sacrifice, according to Hebrews 10:10?
generalrev.explain: We have been made holy through the sacrifice of Jesus once for all.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 6:19 calls our hope an anchor for what?
generalrev.explain: This hope is an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

generalrev.q: Which hero of faith, as he was dying, gave instructions about his bones?
generalrev.explain: By faith Joseph spoke of the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.

generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:16 says Esau sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son for a single meal.

generalrev.q: James 1:27 says pure religion looks after whom in their distress?
generalrev.explain: Religion that God accepts looks after orphans and widows in their distress.

generalrev.q: James 4:14 compares life to what?
generalrev.explain: Life is a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:3 says we have been born again into a living hope through what?
generalrev.a: The resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead
options: The resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead
generalrev.explain: By God's mercy we have a living hope through Jesus' resurrection from the dead.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:18-19 says we were redeemed not with silver or gold, but with what?
generalrev.explain: We were redeemed with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 4:12 says not to be surprised at what?
generalrev.a: The fiery ordeal that comes to test you
options: The fiery ordeal that comes to test you
generalrev.explain: Peter tells believers not to be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on them as testing.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 5:4, what is the victory that has overcome the world?
generalrev.explain: This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

generalrev.q: How does John end his first letter, in 1 John 5:21?
generalrev.explain: The final words of 1 John are: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:22 says to be merciful to whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude says: Be merciful to those who doubt.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 2:17, the one who is victorious receives a white stone with what written on it?
generalrev.explain: Jesus promises a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.

generalrev.q: What do the four living creatures cry day and night in Revelation 4:8?
generalrev.explain: They never stop saying: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:6, how did the Lamb appear standing in the throne room?
generalrev.a: As though it had been slain
options: As though it had been slain
generalrev.explain: John saw a Lamb looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne.

generalrev.q: What title is written on the rider's robe and thigh in Revelation 19:16?
generalrev.a: King of kings and Lord of lords
options: King of kings and Lord of lords
generalrev.explain: On his robe and thigh is written: King of kings and Lord of lords.

generalrev.q: What is the final verse of the Bible about?
generalrev.a: The grace of the Lord Jesus
options: The grace of the Lord Jesus
generalrev.explain: The Bible ends: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God's people. Amen.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 7:2 says the name of Melchizedek, king of Salem, means king of what?
generalrev.explain: Melchizedek is king of righteousness, and also king of Salem, meaning king of peace.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:24 says the sprinkled blood of Jesus speaks a better word than the blood of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jesus' blood speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

generalrev.q: According to James 5:14, whom should a sick person call to pray over them?
generalrev.explain: The sick person should call the elders of the church to pray and anoint with oil in the Lord's name.

generalrev.q: How many people does 1 Peter 3:20 say were saved through water in Noah's ark?
generalrev.explain: Only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 3:15-16, whose letters does Peter mention as containing some hard-to-understand things?
generalrev.explain: Peter refers to our dear brother Paul and his letters.

generalrev.q: To whom is the letter of 3 John addressed?
generalrev.explain: 3 John begins: The elder, to my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

generalrev.q: Along with Cain and Balaam, Jude 1:11 names the rebellion of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude warns of the way of Cain, the error of Balaam and the rebellion of Korah.

generalrev.q: John addresses the seven churches located in which Roman province?
generalrev.explain: John writes to the seven churches in the province of Asia.

generalrev.q: In which city was Antipas, the faithful witness, put to death?
generalrev.explain: Jesus mentions Antipas, my faithful witness, put to death in Pergamum.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:8, the golden bowls of incense are said to be what?
generalrev.explain: The elders held golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people.
